subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 – Lesson 4: Book club – A picture story
outcomes: I can name the features of a picture story.
I can answer questions about the story "No Wi-Fi!"
I can use expressions with do, like do a puzzle.

tf.s: In a picture story, pictures tell the story.
tf.why: Yes! The pictures help tell the story.

tf.s: A picture story usually has only one character.
tf.why: A picture story often has many characters.

tf.s: Samar can't do athletics because it's raining.
Nawal's idea is to put on a show.
tf.why: Correct! Nawal says "Let's put on a show!"

tf.s: Samar loves playing the piano at the start of the story.
tf.why: Samar says "I hate playing the piano."

tf.s: The children are sad after the show.
tf.why: They say "That was fantastic!" and have fun.

tf.s: We say "do homework" and "do a puzzle".
tf.why: Great! These are collocations with do.

tf.s: We write what characters say in speech bubbles.
tf.why: Yes, speech bubbles show the words characters say.

tf.s: In the story, the Wi-Fi works all day.
tf.why: There's no Wi-Fi in the story.

boxes.why: Nawal wants to put on a show.

boxes.q: Who says "Let's put on a show!"?
In a picture story, ___ tell the story.
What does Samar hate at the start?
boxes.why: She says she hates playing the piano.

boxes.q: What does Samar play before the Wi-Fi stops?
Which is NOT a feature of a picture story?
boxes.why: Picture stories have pictures, speech bubbles and many characters.

hunt.q: Her idea: put on a show
Cards to ask people to come

mcq.q: What are two features of a picture story?
o: Pictures tell the story and there are many characters.
There are no pictures and one character.
It is a song with no words.
mcq.why: Pictures and many characters are features.

mcq.q: In a picture story, what shows the words a character says?
mcq.why: Speech bubbles show what characters say.

o: to do homework or do a puzzle
to go out in the rain
mcq.why: Mum says "Why don't you do your homework … or do a puzzle?"

mcq.q: Which is a collocation with do?
Put the events in order: a) The friends sing. b) Samar plays computer games. c) There's no Wi-Fi.
mcq.why: First games, then no Wi-Fi, then singing.

o: My sister does gymnastics every Friday.
My sister plays gymnastics every Friday.
My sister goes gymnastics every Friday.
My sister makes gymnastics every Friday.

mcq.q: What happens first in the story?
mcq.why: The story starts when there's no Wi-Fi.

mcq.q: How does Samar feel about the piano at the start? How do you know?
o: She hates it, because she says "I hate playing the piano."
She loves it, because she plays every day.
She is happy, because she sings.
She is scared, because it's raining.
mcq.why: Her own words show her feelings.

mcq.q: Were the children happier before or after the show?
o: After, because they had fun together without Wi-Fi.
mcq.why: They say "That was fantastic!" after the show.

mcq.q: What is the message of the story?
o: You can have fun without Wi-Fi.
Computer games are the only fun.
mcq.why: The friends have a great time with no Wi-Fi.
